title: Smiling Young Woman with Pearl Necklace, 1963 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close portrait of a joyful young woman wearing a double-strand pearl necklace and dark tailored jacket, set against a softly draped curtain background. She displays a classic early 1960s bouffant short hairstyle. The photo print is stamped on the front border 'FEB 63', while a handwritten note on the reverse notes 'March 1961 / 2 years ago', indicating the image was originally captured in 1961 and printed in 1963.
